crossRefs.note: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

parallels.note: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

translations.web: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
